title: release-provenance --post requires an npm gitHead the tarball publish route never records
description:
Filed from opum-doc design delegation via the leader, 2026-11-02. NOT YET BRIEFED: do not implement until the leader briefs it after a floor check.

PROBLEM. scripts/qualification/release-provenance.mjs --post requires a gitHead on the published version. npm records gitHead only when publishing from a git checkout. opum-doc read every published @opum-ai/quest version: 0.3.0-0.10.0 carry a gitHead; 0.11.0 onwards, including 0.15.0-rc.1, carry none. So the check cannot pass on the tarball route (npm publish <file> of the qualified bundle). It stopped part D staging at quest 0.15.0-rc.1, which opum-doc ruled stands: staged, byte-identical, receipt:verify-published passed. The same --post would fail promote-release latest step (which publishes @opum-ai/quest@0.15.0 from final/<X>.tgz) and release.yml:378 whenever publish=true.

INTENT (QCLI-267 stands): the registry record must name the released commit, and the fix must be satisfiable on the route that actually publishes. Related: QCLI-280 (the same gate checks the unsigned gitHead, not the signed SLSA attestation).

OPTIONS.
Preferred: the packed launcher package.json carries gitHead=<released sha>, IF npm keeps that field from a tarball manifest. This must be measured, not assumed.
Fallback: --post verifies the served tarball integrity against the receipt that binds the sha, instead of reading gitHead.

RAIL FOR WHOEVER IMPLEMENTS IT: measure on a scratch package first, with a positive control, and keep that measurement LOCAL: npm pack, npm publish --dry-run, and inspecting the manifest. Any real publish, even of a scratch package, is registry publication, tier 3, the operators own action, and never moves on instruction from any session.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The gitHead route is decided under DEC-251 (a3), by construction, not by a local measurement (DEC-251 a4). The local measurement is recorded with its limit: npm pack on a scratch package carries a planted gitHead and changes the tarball sha256 (2fff881e versus aa4828d0), and npm publish --dry-run shows neither the gitHead nor what a registry would record, so there is no registry-side evidence. No real publish of any package, scratch included, was performed by the implementer

release-provenance.mjs --post has a clean case that passes on the tarball route that promote-release latest step and release.yml publish=true use, proved by a test that also shows it still rejects a version whose provenance does not name the released commit

The chosen option (launcher manifest gitHead, or served-tarball integrity against the receipt binding the sha) is recorded in the runbook next to the --post gate, naming which route it was measured on

QCLI-267 intent is preserved: the check still fails when the registry record cannot be tied to the released commit, and release.yml calls --post with the same satisfiable check. The post-promotion check is the documented hand step (gh run download of the quest-candidate-bundle, then --post --bundle --run-id); wiring promote-release to it is QCLI-557 (DEC-251 a5)

implementationNotes: ROUTE (2026-11-02): the FALLBACK, per the leader dispatch rails. MEASUREMENT, local only: npm 12.2.1, scratch package, npm pack with and without a gitHead in the source package.json. Positive control in one run: with gitHead the packed manifest keys are name, version, gitHead and gitHead reads the planted sha; without it the keys are name, version and gitHead reads null. So a tarball CAN carry gitHead. NOT shown: whether the registry keeps or serves it for a tarball publish; that needs a real publish, the operators, so it is unmeasured and the preferred route is not taken. Rail 2: it would also change the 0.15.0 final launcher bytes. IMPLEMENTATION: release-provenance.mjs --post, when the registry records NO gitHead, requires --bundle <dir>: the bundle evidence/package-metadata.json sourceCommit must equal the released sha, and npm dist.integrity for the launcher at --version must equal the bundle tarball sha512 (tarballs/ for the rc, final/ for X). A recorded gitHead is still compared and a mismatch still fails. release.yml post step passes --bundle candidate; the runbook hand-run command and a rationale section are updated. Test test/qcli555-provenance-tarball-route.test.ts, 9 cases against a stub npm on PATH; 5 mutations each turned red exactly the predicted tests. No launcher bytes, package.json, lockfile, pin or dependency touched.

REVISION 2026-11-02 after the Opus review of 65fed094 (REQUEST CHANGES, F1-F6). F1: --post no longer binds to the bundle self-asserted sourceCommit; with no registry gitHead it runs requireQualification on --bundle with --run-id (receipt commit, run, and the launcher tarball sha256: tarballs entry for the rc, launcherSubstitution.finalTarball for X) and then compares npm served sha512 against that bundle tarball, directory chosen by rc vs X. New module provenance-tarball-route.mjs; release.yml post step takes the existing E2E_RECEIPT_READ_TOKEN env exactly as the receipt gate does, no secret added. F2: documented as a hand step with the bundle source (gh run download <run-id> --name quest-candidate-bundle), promote-release not changed. F3, AC0: AC0 names npm pack AND npm publish --dry-run. Ran both locally (scratch package, dead registry, nothing published). pack: with a planted gitHead the manifest carries it, without it null, sha256 of the two tarballs differs (2fff881e vs aa4828d0). dry-run: lists contents and integrity only and shows neither the manifest gitHead nor what a registry would record, so it adds no registry-side evidence. The route was decided by DEC-251 (a3) by construction, not by this measurement; AC0 is left UNTICKED and unreworded for the leader to take to opum-doc.

RECORD 2026-11-02, after #723 merged as fb2f6b46. AC0 amended and ticked under DEC-251 (a4) (opum-doc ruling, option A): the route was decided by construction under (a3); the local measurement is recorded with its limit. AC3 amended and ticked under DEC-251 (a5) (option A): release.yml calls --post, the post-promotion check is the documented hand step, and wiring promote-release to it is QCLI-557. AC1 stays UNTICKED: the Opus review N1 found that no QCLI-555 test drives the real receipt gate through the route, so the accept half is unproven through it; that is QCLI-558, which also carries N2 (single read of the served integrity). AC2 left unticked here. QCLI-555 stays In Progress. Next-release preferred route (a3) is QCLI-556. None of these gates 0.15.0.

AC2 ticked 2026-11-02 on a re-read of docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md at fb2f6b46 (the #723 squash), not on the reviewers score. Lines 790-807 ("Why --post takes --bundle and --run-id (QCLI-555, DEC-251 a3)") record the chosen route: with no registry gitHead, --post runs the opum-cli-e2e receipt gate on --bundle and compares the served sha512 against the receipt-bound bundle tarball, next to the --post gate command at 784-788. Lines 819-827 record the not-chosen gitHead-in-package.json route with the local npm pack measurement (npm 12.2.1, scratch package, positive control) and that the registry side is unmeasured. Lines 814-817 give the post-promotion hand step. The route is named as the tarball route throughout.
